presets.name: Lower voice
presets.note: Softens “s” and “sh” around 5–6 kHz, working only above the split.

presets.name: Higher voice
presets.note: Softens sibilance around 7 kHz, for a higher speaking or singing voice.

presets.name: Gentle de-ess
presets.note: Light 3:1 reduction for a voice that is only a little bright.
